neighbours.label: digits inside a hexadecimal colour code ('#RRGGBB')
fire: The designer asked for the header to use #1a2b3c instead of black.
In the CSS, set border-color: #996633; on every card.
Our brand green is #2e8b57, so please match it exactly.
The button turns #ff6347 when the user hovers over it.
Use the hex value #708090 for the muted text.
The logo's orange, #ff8c00, looks dull on print.
quiet: The designer asked for the header to be 120 pixels tall.
In the CSS, set border-width: 3px; on every card.
Our brand guide is version 4, so please match it exactly.
The button turns red after 30 seconds of inactivity.
Use a font size of 14 for the muted text.
The logo printed at 300 dpi looks dull on paper.

notes: Probe: #262626 0.95, #009c98 0.90, '#FF9800' 0.62, #3399FF 0.39; phone 0.14, year 0.02, 0x9F 0.22, version 2.6.9 0.34. Near misses keep digit strings in code/design text without a hex colour.
